what: AR14, the base dressed: where Lantern Row's kit stands on a plot, by the base's level
kit: build/handoff/LanternRow/manifest.json: every piece named here is one of its pieces, published already
origin: the middle of the plot's front edge (the edge on the Strip), on the plot's floor
axes: `across` is the plot's own +X, to the right as the spawn looks; `along` is studs out of the front edge toward the Strip, so everything on the plot is negative; `turn` is degrees anticlockwise seen from above
toRoblox: in the plot's own frame (WorldService.plot's `at`), Kit.Place(placement, piece, front, floorY) with front = -deep / 2: CFrame.new(across, floorY, front - along) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(turn), 0) * centre. A light the same way, by Kit.Light.

1.name: the yard
1.idea: a paved court round the machines, between two low houses a side: two lantern strings run in from the front, one down each lane beside the Breaker; roped lamp posts at the court's sides; banners at the Festival Door

levelMark.note: the level's number over the board's script, on both faces, in cream (#E8D8C0): the builder's text until the gate has a piece of its own

pavingNote: each rectangle wears the kit's paving tile (LanternRow_Paving_Color.png, 8 studs square), as the street's own floor does; the StreetBay runners lie over it, as in Lantern Row

ground.note: the lot is the plot's floor beyond the court: the paving tile too, its Texture's Color3 at `lot`, so the court is the brighter stone (the Kept and Tower overlays take it too, unmarked). The ground is the slab between plots, a flat colour. The Strip and the side street wear the paving tile untinted, as Lantern Row's floor does.

standIns.note: until each machine has its model: the boxes in the kit's colours, so nothing on a plot is grey. One lit-wood body for every machine, the stalls' own, and one accent each; the chambers glow (Neon).

lighting: the base stands under Lantern Row's dusk: the same sky, ambient, fog and bloom (build/handoff/LanternRow/sky/lighting.json). Under the place's daylight the lanterns don't read.
lightsNote: as Lantern Row's: a SpotLight straight down from each lane string's middle and a PointLight over the Breaker's chambers, Shadows off; every other pool is painted in a runner's glow picture
collision: as Lantern Row's kit: the strings, the banners and the runners are look only; a post follows its mesh and its rope is a low wall; the sign keeps its box
